A closer look

Understand the details.

Elken lists hydrogen goggles alongside inhalation and hydrogen water. Ask Farra to explain the accessory and its use before a session. This page makes no claim that the goggles treat an eye condition.

  • The goggles are shown as a system accessory
  • The trial promotion lists hydrogen goggles as an inclusion
  • Ask about fitting, cleaning and individual-use arrangements
  • Use only according to the actual manufacturer instructions

Manufacturer information describes the product platform; confirm the specific unit and accessories supplied by Farra. Styled imagery is illustrative.
